label: Summed score - total score out of 24 - Epsworth Sleepiness Scale - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: Summed score - total score out of 24 - Epsworth Sleepiness Scale - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 Epworth Sleepiness Scale - participants were asked to rate how likely they are to fall asleep in eight different situations, and the score from each situation was summed to give a total score out of 24. A total score of 16 or more indicates a high level of daytime sleepiness. Not administered at phase 1.
cat_rows: This category contains questions about activing out dreams (phase 1); several validated sleep questionnaires (phase 2): Epworth Sleepiness Questionnaire, Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), REM Sleep Behaviour Disorder Screening Questionnaire (RBDSQ) of the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values and distribution outside 5th and 95th percentiles removed from both the plot and the statistics above.
